subject: Secure SDLC evidence: PR gating, pipeline controls, and secret-scanning artifacts
messages:
From: elaine@crestwood-audit.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SDLC evidence for PR gating and secret scanning

Hi Jonas,

As part of the SOC 2 scoping for Redwood Inference, we're collecting concrete artifacts demonstrating your secure SDLC controls focused on code review gates, CI/CD deployment approvals, and secrets scanning. Specifically, could you provide the following items scoped to the last 6 months: 

- A sample of PR approval records showing enforced reviewer counts and approvers (redacted where necessary)
- CI pipeline execution logs that show gated deployment steps and manual approval events
- Results from automated secret-scanning runs and remediation tickets
- The current deployment gating policy (the doc developers follow)
- A short attestation (signed) from an engineering manager confirming controls in practice

If you can bundle these files and any links to internal runbooks, we'll include them in the evidence pack. Let us know if you have questions or need to narrow scope.

Thanks,
Elaine Martin
Senior Assessor
Crestwood Audit Partners

Attachments requested: list template (optional)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: elaine@crestwood-audit.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence for PR gating and secret scanning

Hi Elaine —

Thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble the requested artifacts and provide a short attestation. Plan:

- I'll export PR approval traces and a small set of redacted screenshots showing reviewer enforcement.
- Dev will pull the CI logs for the last 6 months and flag any manual approval steps.
- Marcus will attach the most recent secret-scan run and link to remediation Jira tickets.
- We'll include the official Deploy Gate policy (v1.2) and an attestation signed by me.

Target delivery: Monday, 2026-11-15 EOD PST. If you need anything sooner (specific repos or a narrower timeframe), tell us and we'll prioritize.

Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence for PR gating and secret scanning

Jonas / team — quick status update as I collect artifacts: 

- PR approvals: I exported the audit trail for main and release branches. The export includes timestamps, reviewer IDs, and approval counts. Redacted user emails for privacy; kept GitHub handles.
- CI/CD: Dev pulled pipeline runs for 6 repos that represent our production path. Filtered to deployments that triggered a manual approval gate. CSV has run ids and step timestamps.
- Secret-scan: Running the last two scans produced 3 findings flagged as false positives; remediation tickets exist for two low-severity leaks and are resolved. I included the raw JSON from the scanner and a summarized CSV.

Notes: the deploy-gate policy references two Jira workflows (INFRA-1983 and INFRA-1990). The policy also describes automatic rollback conditions and who can approve production releases (Engineering Managers + Release Engineers).

I'll attach the artifacts to the bundle and prepare a short human-readable index that maps files to your request list.

Grace O'Connor
Engineering Manager, Reliability
Redwood Inference

--

Subject: Fwd: Secure SDLC evidence bundle (PR gating, CI logs, secret-scan)

Elaine — attaching the evidence bundle per your request. Summary of attachments below and a short attestation.

Attachments included (redacted where appropriate):
- pr-approval-audit-20261109.png — exported PR approval screenshots showing enforced minimum reviewers = 2, required CODEOWNERS enforcement for release branches.
- ci-pipeline-logs-20261109.csv — pipeline run ids, step timestamps, and manual approval events for deployments to production during the 6-month window.
- secretscan-report-20261108.json — JSON results from our secret-scanning tool; includes findings and remediation ticket IDs.
- deploy-gate-policy-v1.2.pdf — current deployment gating policy (public/internal sections).
- attestation-signed-jonas-20261115.pdf — signed attestation from me confirming the controls above are enforced and monitored.

Attestation (text):
I, Jonas Weber, Director of Platform Security at Redwood Inference, attest that the attached artifacts accurately reflect our secure SDLC controls in place for the named repositories and environments for the period May 1, 2026 — Oct 31, 2026. Our controls include enforced PR approvals, automated secret scanning with documented remediation, and gated production deployments requiring manual approvals per the attached policy.

If you need deeper exports (full repo names, raw user emails) we'll work with legal/privacy to provide narrow-scoped data under an NDA.

Thanks,
Jonas
